title: Look Before You Leap: Re-Architecting Disk-Resident Vector Search with TriVS
abstract: arXiv:2611.29948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Disk-resident approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) scales vector search beyond DRAM, yet state-of-the-art systems remain I/O-bound, even with fast SSDs and sophisticated I/O execution. To understand this bottleneck, we conduct an I/O-centric analysis that breaks each query down into an approach phase that locates a query-near region and a converge phase that resolves the final top-k. This analysis reveals complementary I/O tradeoffs: cluster-based search circumvents approach-phase I/O through in-memory routing but reads coarse-grained, full clusters during convergence, whereas graph-based search employs fine-grained, vector-level I/O throughout, enabling efficient convergence at the cost of inevitable I/O during the approach phase.   To combine the complementary I/O benefits of the two granularities, we present TriVS, a new paradigm that re-architects disk-resident vector search as a trilogy: approach coarsely, distill progressiv

translated_title: 三思而后行：使用TriVS重新架构磁盘驻留向量搜索
translated_abstract: 磁盘驻留近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）将向量搜索的规模扩展到DRAM之外，然而即使采用快速SSD和复杂的I/O执行机制，最先进的系统仍然受限于I/O瓶颈。为了理解这一瓶颈，我们进行了以I/O为中心的分析，将每个查询分解为两个阶段：定位查询邻近区域的方法阶段和求解最终top-k结果的收敛阶段。这一分析揭示了两种互补的I/O权衡：基于聚类的搜索通过内存中的路由规避了方法阶段的I/O，但在收敛阶段需要读取粗粒度的完整簇；而基于图的搜索在整个过程中采用细粒度的向量级I/O，以方法阶段不可避免的I/O开销为代价，实现了高效的收敛。为了结合这两种粒度的互补I/O优势，我们提出了TriVS，一种新的范式，将磁盘驻留向量搜索重新架构为三部曲：粗略接近、渐进蒸馏……
tldr: TriVS通过以I/O为中心的分析揭示了基于聚类与基于图的搜索在I/O上的互补权衡，并创新性地将磁盘驻留向量搜索重构为“粗略接近、渐进蒸馏、精细收敛”的三部曲范式，融合两种粒度的I/O优势以突破I/O瓶颈。
